sentences.en: The train was not so crowded as I had expected.
sentences.zh: 这列火车没有我想象中的那么拥挤。

sentences.en: Seaside resorts, such as Newport, are very crowded in summer.
sentences.zh: 像纽波特这样的海滨度假胜地在夏天非常拥挤。

sentences.en: I heard someone call my name in the crowded bus.
sentences.zh: 我在拥挤的公交车上听到有人叫我名字。
